sets.title: Introduction to Systems of Linear Equations
sets.learningGoals: Recognize linear equations, translate between equations and matrices, check solutions, describe free variables, and model a diet problem.

sets.title: Gaussian Elimination
sets.learningGoals: Compare Gaussian and Gauss–Jordan elimination, interpret pivots and free variables, test consistency, and fit a curve.

sets.title: Matrices and Matrix Operations
sets.learningGoals: Check matrix sizes, calculate sums and products, connect multiplication to linear combinations, and model costs.

sets.title: Inverses; Algebraic Properties of Matrices
sets.learningGoals: Use transpose and inverse rules, solve systems with an inverse, and understand why scalar algebra rules can fail for matrices.

sets.title: Elementary Matrices and a Method for Finding A−1
sets.learningGoals: Connect row operations to elementary matrices, compute inverses, recognize singular cases, and explain row equivalence.

sets.title: More on Linear Systems and Invertible Matrices
sets.learningGoals: Use inverse matrices for multiple right-hand sides and connect invertibility to consistency and homogeneous systems.

sets.title: Diagonal, Triangular, and Symmetric Matrices
sets.learningGoals: Recognize special matrix structures, use efficient calculations, and distinguish symmetry from triangularity and invertibility.

sets.title: Introduction to Linear Transformations
sets.learningGoals: Connect formulas to matrix transformations, identify domain and codomain, and interpret reflections, rotations, and linearity.

sets.title: Compositions of Matrix Transformations
sets.learningGoals: Understand composition order, compute combined transformations, and connect geometric reversibility to inverses.

sets.title: Applications of Linear Systems
sets.learningGoals: Build linear models for flows, traffic, circuits, chemical reactions, and polynomial interpolation.

sets.title: Leontief Input-Output Models
sets.learningGoals: Translate economic exchanges into matrices, distinguish open and closed economies, and interpret feasible production.

sets.title: Determinants by Cofactor Expansion
sets.learningGoals: Connect minors and cofactors to determinants, exploit structure, and interpret zero determinants geometrically.

sets.title: Evaluating Determinants by Row Reduction
sets.learningGoals: Track how row operations change determinants and combine reduction with structural reasoning.

sets.title: Properties of Determinants; Cramer’s Rule
sets.learningGoals: Use determinants to test invertibility, solve systems with Cramer’s rule, and reason about products and scaling.

sets.title: Vectors in 2-Space, 3-Space, and n-Space
sets.learningGoals: Move between geometric and coordinate descriptions, form linear combinations, and reason about parallel vectors.

sets.title: Norm, Dot Product, and Distance in Rn
sets.learningGoals: Calculate lengths, dot products, and angles; distinguish vectors from scalars; and connect inequalities to geometry.

sets.title: Orthogonality
sets.learningGoals: Use orthogonality to describe planes, calculate projections and distances, and interpret work done by a force.

sets.title: The Geometry of Linear Systems
sets.learningGoals: Translate between parametric, vector, and equation descriptions of lines, planes, and solution spaces.

sets.title: Cross Product
sets.learningGoals: Use cross products for perpendicular directions, areas, volumes, orientation, and torque.

sets.title: Real Vector Spaces
sets.learningGoals: Test vector-space axioms across familiar and unfamiliar operations, and explain why examples fail.

sets.title: Subspaces
sets.learningGoals: Apply the subspace test to vectors, matrices, polynomials, and functions; connect kernels to geometry.

sets.title: Spanning Sets
sets.learningGoals: Build and test spanning sets in several vector spaces and explain when different sets span the same space.

sets.title: Linear Independence
sets.learningGoals: Recognize dependence, test independence, investigate parameters, and connect algebraic and functional examples.

sets.title: Coordinates and Basis
sets.learningGoals: Choose bases, calculate coordinates in different spaces, and distinguish spanning from independence.

sets.title: Dimension
sets.learningGoals: Find bases and dimensions, extend independent sets, remove redundant vectors, and connect dimension to solution spaces.

sets.title: Change of Basis
sets.learningGoals: Compute and interpret change-of-basis matrices, track direction and order, and relate coordinate changes to geometry.

sets.title: Row Space, Column Space, and Null Space
sets.learningGoals: Connect consistency to column space, compute bases for fundamental spaces, and interpret homogeneous and nonhomogeneous solutions.

sets.title: Rank, Nullity, and the Fundamental Matrix Spaces
sets.learningGoals: Calculate rank and nullity, identify the fundamental matrix spaces, and reason about their dimensions and orthogonality.

sets.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
sets.learningGoals: Check eigenpairs, find eigenspaces, use geometric transformations, and connect eigenvalues to characteristic polynomials.

sets.title: Diagonalization
sets.learningGoals: Decide whether diagonalization is possible, build an eigenbasis, and distinguish algebraic from geometric multiplicity.

sets.title: Complex Vector Spaces
sets.learningGoals: Work with complex vectors and conjugation, calculate complex eigenpairs, and connect real matrices with complex eigenvalues.

sets.title: Differential Equations
sets.learningGoals: Solve systems of differential equations using eigenvalues, impose initial conditions, and connect higher-order equations to systems.

sets.title: Dynamical Systems and Markov Chains
sets.learningGoals: Interpret stochastic matrices, calculate state evolution and steady states, and model transitions in real situations.

sets.title: Inner Products
sets.learningGoals: Compare inner products on vectors, matrices, and functions; calculate lengths; and test which axioms matter.

sets.title: Angle and Orthogonality in Inner Product Spaces
sets.learningGoals: Compute angles and orthogonal complements in different inner-product spaces, then explain the underlying structure.

sets.title: Gram–Schmidt Process; QR-Decomposition
sets.learningGoals: Build orthonormal bases, calculate projections, apply Gram–Schmidt in different spaces, and compute a QR decomposition.

sets.title: Best Approximation; Least Squares
sets.learningGoals: Solve least-squares problems, compare exact and approximate solutions, and connect projections to normal equations and QR.

sets.title: Mathematical Modeling Using Least Squares
sets.learningGoals: Fit lines and transformed curves, construct design matrices, and explain when a least-squares fit is unique.

sets.title: Function Approximation; Fourier Series
sets.learningGoals: Approximate functions with polynomials and trigonometric sums, calculate errors, and build Fourier series.

sets.title: Orthogonal Matrices
sets.learningGoals: Recognize orthogonal matrices, use transpose inverses, describe rotations, and explain their geometric properties.

sets.title: Orthogonal Diagonalization
sets.learningGoals: Build orthonormal eigenbases, compute orthogonal diagonalizations, and interpret spectral decompositions.

sets.title: Quadratic Forms
sets.learningGoals: Write quadratic forms as matrices, eliminate cross terms, classify conics, and distinguish types of definiteness.

sets.title: Optimization Using Quadratic Forms
sets.learningGoals: Use eigenvalues to optimize quadratic forms under constraints and connect definiteness to critical-point classification.

sets.title: Hermitian, Unitary, and Normal Matrices
sets.learningGoals: Connect conjugate transpose, Hermitian and unitary matrices, complex eigenvalues, and unitary diagonalization.

sets.title: General Linear Transformations
sets.learningGoals: Test linearity beyond coordinate vectors, compute kernels and ranges, and use rank–nullity for general transformations.

sets.title: Compositions and Inverse Transformations
sets.learningGoals: Analyze one-to-one transformations, construct inverses, and track the order of compositions across vector spaces.

sets.title: Isomorphism
sets.learningGoals: Construct and test isomorphisms between different vector spaces and explain which structures they preserve.

sets.title: Matrices for General Linear Transformations
sets.learningGoals: Represent general transformations with matrices, track basis choices, and connect composition and differentiation to matrix products.

sets.title: Similarity
sets.learningGoals: Connect changes of basis to similarity, compare representations of the same operator, and test similarity invariants.

sets.title: Geometry of Matrix Operators
sets.learningGoals: Visualize images of shapes, decompose transformations, and distinguish the effects of shear, scaling, rotation, and reflection.

sets.title: LU-Decompositions
sets.learningGoals: Factor matrices into LU and PLU forms, solve systems efficiently, and understand when pivoting is needed.

sets.title: The Power Method
sets.learningGoals: Identify dominant eigenvalues, compare power-method scalings, and investigate convergence and starting-vector effects.

sets.title: Comparison of Procedures for Solving Linear Systems
sets.learningGoals: Count arithmetic operations and compare the computational cost of matrix operations and system-solving methods.

sets.title: Singular Value Decomposition
sets.learningGoals: Calculate singular values and decompositions for different matrix shapes and connect SVD to rank and polar decomposition.

sets.title: Data Compression Using Singular Value Decomposition
sets.learningGoals: Build reduced singular-value decompositions and expansions, then compare storage costs of low-rank approximations.
